strAssignedUserIds.description: string read only The list of users assigned to the work order. The field contains a list of IDs separated by spaces. For example : " 13  8  9 " . For possible values, please refer to the User section.

strAssignedUsers.description: string read only The list of users assigned to the work order. The field contains the full names of the assigned users separated by commas. For example : "John Doe, Samuel Smith" .

strCode.description: string An unique code for referencing the work order. Work order codes are automatically generated by the CMMS. For example : "2009-02-05.0004.00004" .

strCompletedByUserIds.description: string read only A string that identifies the users who completed the work order. Each user ID is separated by white space (e.g. 1234 56789).

strCompletedByUsers.description: string read only A list of the users who completed the work order. The field contains the full names of each of the assigned users, separated by commas (e.g. John Doe, Samuel Smith).

strCompletionNotes.description: string This field can be used to input some notes upon the completion of the work order.

strCustomerIds.description: string read only A string that identifies the customer associated with the work order. Each customer ID is separated by white space (e.g. 1234 56789).

strDescription.description: string A short text describing the work order.

strEmailUserGuest.description: string Work orders can be requested by guests without having to log into the CMMS. In this case, this field gives the email address of the person who submitted the work order.

strNameUserGuest.description: string Work orders can be requested by guests without having to log into the CMMS. In this case, this field gives the name of the person who submitted the work order.

strPhoneUserGuest.description: string Work orders can be requested by guests without having to log into the CMMS. In this case, this field gives the phone number of the person who submitted the work order.

strUuid.description: string read only A unique identifier for the WorkOrder.

strVendorIds.description: string read only A string that identifies the vendor associated with the work order. Each vendor ID is separated by white space (e.g. 1234 56789).

next_cursor.description: Pass to the continuation input to read the next page.

data.description: The response returned by the service.

bolRequiresSignature.description: boolean read only If set to true, indicates that the Work Order requires an ESignature. A Work Order does not need to and cannot be signed if this is set to false.

dtmDateCompleted.description: timestamp The date and time when the work order was completed.

dtmDateCreated.description: timestamp The date and time when the work order was created.

dtmDateLastModified.description: timestamp The date and time when the work order was modified for the last time.

dtmDateSigned.description: timestamp read only The date and time when the work order was signed.

dtmSuggestedCompletionDate.description: timestamp The date and time when the work order should be completed.

dtmSuggestedStartDate.description: timestamp The date and time when the work order should be started.

dv_intAccountID.description: string The strCode and strDescription of the Account associated with the WorkOrder.

dv_intChargeDepartmentID.description: string The strCode and strDescription of the ChargeDepartment associated with the WorkOrder.

dv_intCompletedByUserID.description: string The full name of the user who completed the work order.

dv_intLastModifiedByUserID.description: string The name of the user specified by intLastModifiedByUserID who modified the Work Order.

dv_intMaintenanceTypeID.description: string The display name of the maintenance type of the work order. For example : "Preventive" or "Upgrade" . For getting possible values, please refer to the MaintenanceType section.

dv_intOriginWorkOrderTaskID.description: string The description of the WorkOrderTask associated with intOriginWorkOrderTaskID.

dv_intPriorityID.description: string The display name of the priority level of the work order.

dv_intProjectID.description: string The name of the Project associated with the Work Order.

dv_intRCAActionID.description: string For Enterprise tenants only. This field displays the action/solution value for a problem code. Problems, causes, and actions must be configured in the tenant to use this field.

dv_intRCACauseID.description: string For Enterprise tenants only. This field displays the root cause value for a problem code. Problems, causes, and actions must be configured in the tenant to use this field.

dv_intRCAProblemID.description: string For Enterprise tenants only. This field displays the problem code value for a problem code. Problems, causes, and actions must be configured in the tenant to use this field.

dv_intRequestedByUserID.description: string The full name of the user who requested the work order.

dv_intScheduledMaintenanceID.description: string The code that uniquely identifies the ScheduledMaintenance .

dv_intSignedByUserID.description: string The name of the user specified by intSignedByUserID who signed the WorkOrder.

dv_intSiteID.description: string For a multi-site tenant, the name and the code of the site the work order is related to.

dv_intWorkOrderStatusID.description: string The display name of the current status of the work order.
